audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle construction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for ark, cover, cherubim, table, lampstand, incense altar, anointing oil, incense.

verses.restored: Bezalel made ark of acacia wood: two and a half cubits its length, one and a half cubits its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

familiar.text: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

modern.text: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

original.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת הָאָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made for it gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

modern.text: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

original.text: וַיְצַפֵּ֛הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He cast for it four gold rings upon its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on other side.

familiar.text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

modern.text: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.

original.text: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּע֔וֹת עַל צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

familiar.text: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

modern.text: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: He brought poles into rings on sides of ark, to carry ark.

familiar.text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

modern.text: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it. The Mercy Seat (Exodus 25:17–22)

original.text: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת הָאָרֹֽן

verses.restored: He made cover/atonement-cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits its length and one and a half cubits its width.

familiar.text: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

modern.text: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כַּפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ

verses.restored: He made two cherubim of gold; of hammered work he made them from two ends of cover.

familiar.text: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

modern.text: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,

original.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֥י כְרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת

verses.restored: One cherub from this end and one cherub from that end; from cover he made cherubim from its two ends.

familiar.text: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

modern.text: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.

original.text: כְּרוּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים מִשְּׁנֵ֥י קצוותו

verses.restored: The cherubim spread wings upward, sheltering cover with their wings, and their faces each toward the other; toward the cover were faces of cherubim.

familiar.text: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

modern.text: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat. The Table of Showbread (Exodus 25:23–30; Leviticus 24:5–9)

original.text: וַיִּהְי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑יו אֶל הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים

verses.restored: He made table of acacia wood: two cubits its length, one cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

familiar.text: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

modern.text: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He overlaid it with pure gold and made for it gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

modern.text: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

original.text: וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He made for it rim of handbreadth all around and made gold molding for its rim all around.

familiar.text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

modern.text: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

original.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ זֵר זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He cast for it four gold rings and put rings on four corners that were on its four feet.

familiar.text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

modern.text: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.

original.text: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו

verses.restored: Close to rim were rings, housings for poles to carry table.

familiar.text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

modern.text: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

original.text: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת בָּתִּים֙ לַבַּדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן

verses.restored: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold, to carry table.

familiar.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

modern.text: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.

original.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן

verses.restored: He made vessels on table: its dishes, pans, bowls, and jars to pour libations, of pure gold.

familiar.text: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

modern.text: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus 25:31–40; Numbers 8:1–4)

original.text: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת הַכֵּלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת קְעָרֹתָ֤יו וְאֶת כַּפֹּתָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו וְאֶת הַקְּשָׂוֺ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: He made lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work he made lampstand, its base, stem, cups, bulbs, and blossoms from it.

familiar.text: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

modern.text: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה הָיֽוּ

verses.restored: Six branches went out from its sides, three branches of lampstand from one side and three branches from other side.

familiar.text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

modern.text: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.

original.text: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי

verses.restored: Three almond-blossom cups on one branch, bulb and blossom, and three almond-blossom cups on another branch, bulb and blossom; so for six branches going out from lampstand.

familiar.text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

modern.text: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.

original.text: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַמְּנֹרָֽה

verses.restored: On lampstand itself four almond-blossom cups, its bulbs and blossoms.

familiar.text: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

modern.text: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

original.text: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: A bulb under two branches from it, a bulb under two branches from it, and a bulb under two branches from it, for six branches going from it.

familiar.text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

modern.text: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.

original.text: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּֽחַת שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנָּה

verses.restored: Their bulbs and branches were from it; all of it one hammered work of pure gold.

familiar.text: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

modern.text: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

original.text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה הָי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: He made its seven lamps, its tongs, and firepans of pure gold.

familiar.text: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

modern.text: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: From a talent of pure gold he made it and all its vessels.

familiar.text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

modern.text: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold. The Altar of Incense (Exodus 30:1–10)

original.text: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל כֵּלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: He made incense altar of acacia wood: one cubit its length and one cubit its width, square, and two cubits its height; its horns from it.

familiar.text: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

modern.text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.

original.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּ֣ה אָרְכּוֹ֩ וְאַמָּ֨ה רָחְבּ֜וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְאַמָּתַ֨יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֥וּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top, sides all around, and horns, and made gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

modern.text: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.

original.text: וַיְצַ֨ף אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He made two gold rings under molding on two sides, as housings for poles to carry it with them.

familiar.text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

modern.text: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה ל֣וֹ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

familiar.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

modern.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: He made holy anointing oil and pure fragrant incense, work of perfumer.

familiar.text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

modern.text: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.

original.text: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶת שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים טָה֑וֹר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽחַ

translation_notes: Construction fulfills the mountain pattern of Exodus 25 and 30.
Portable presence remains emphasized through poles for ark, table, and incense altar.
Lampstand retains almond/tree imagery and one hammered-work unity.
Bezalel is named as lead maker, preserving artisan agency.
safety_note: This chapter honors skilled craft as faithful execution of sacred pattern. Do not flatten technical repetition; the repetition shows command becoming embodied work.
